name: The Knife of the Traitor
source:
Bones and guts, bones and guts.
The Kingdom of Ulla was made of the bones and guts of their enemies.

The new successor to the throne was the bloodthirstiest of all the heirs.
But inside the kingdom was a traitor.

He brought down all.
Even the new successor.
And all traces of her vanished mysteriously...

...Until today.

Lady Os has awaken from her cursed slumber…with a knife in her neck. Search the tower to find the culprit!

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14640]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
白骨与内脏，白骨与内脏。
乌拉王国是由敌人的白骨与内脏筑成的。

新任王位继承人是所有继承者中最嗜血的一个。
但王国内部潜伏着一个叛徒。

他摧毁了一切。
包括新的继承人。
她的一切痕迹都神秘地消失了……

……直到今天。

奥丝夫人从被诅咒的沉睡中醒来……脖子上插着一把匕首。搜寻高塔，找出凶手！
